use Ghul.Pipes
use Raster.IMAGE
use System.Math

let turns = 5.0D
let steps = 2000

let last = turns * 2.0D * Math.pi

at(angle: double) -> (x: double, y: double) =>
    (x = angle * Math.cos(angle), y = angle * Math.sin(angle))

let image = IMAGE(400, 400)

image.view(-last, -last, last, last)

image.colour(0ub, 0ub, 160ub)
image.stroke(1.5D)

image.line(
    (0..steps + 1)
        |> map(step => at(last * cast double(step) / cast double(steps)))
        |> collect_list()
)

image.write("spiral.png")

image.show("spiral.png")

use Ghul.Pipes
use Raster.IMAGE
use System.Math

let turns = 5.0D
let steps = 2000

let last = turns * 2.0D * Math.pi

at(angle: double) -> (x: double, y: double) =>
    (x = angle * Math.cos(angle), y = angle * Math.sin(angle))

let image = IMAGE(400, 400)

image.view(-last, -last, last, last)

image.colour(0ub, 0ub, 160ub)
image.stroke(1.5D)

image.line(
    (0..steps + 1)
        |> map(step => at(last * cast double(step) / cast double(steps)))
        |> collect_list()
)

image.write("spiral.png")

image.show("spiral.png")
